title: Create the workspace's design-system library
description: Scaffold the design system every BeSpunky project is born with: the framework-NEUTRAL core — design tokens as CSS custom properties (the runtime layer) plus a zero-output SASS API (token accessors, the theme() emission, mixins, placeholders) — bound to the workspace's framework when it has one (Angular: a publishable @nx/angular library with DsTheme/provideDesignSystem and the ng-packagr sass channel; components via ds-component), or else carrying a plain-DOM setMode() runtime as a source library. Ships zero components and zero opinionated visual styles; token VALUES are loudly-marked placeholders replaced wholesale by the design phase. Opens the sass channel on every app whose stack has a styles port (via design-system-styles) and installs the binding's provider. An existing design system keeps the binding it was born with. Idempotent: styles/ and src/ are SEEDED (written only if absent); the config, tags, docs and app wiring are re-asserted on every run.

name.description: The library (and Nx project) name. Also seeds the default directory (<detected-libs-dir>/<name>) and import path (@<scope>/<name>).

scope.description: The npm scope for the import path, WITHOUT the leading `@` (e.g. `acme` -> `@acme/design-system`). Defaults to the workspace's scope (the root package.json name, else the workspace directory name).

importPath.description: Full override of the npm import path (wins over --scope), e.g. `@acme/design-system`.

directory.description: Workspace-relative directory for the library. Defaults to `<libs-dir>/<name>`, where `<libs-dir>` is DETECTED from the workspace: `nx.json` `workspaceLayout.libsDir` if set, else inferred from where existing libraries live (so a `libs/` workspace gets `libs/`), else the house default `packages`. The app's sass load path is derived from this directory's PARENT, so the in-repo specifier is always `<dir-name>/styles`.

prefix.description: The component-selector prefix for components later promoted into the design system (framework bindings only).

tokenPrefix.description: The CSS custom-property namespace: `ds` yields `--ds-color-surface` and the `[data-ds-mode]` theming attribute.

wireProviders.description: Wire this layer's provider into the app's app.config.ts. TRUE ONLY WHEN ENSURING the layer (creating the capability) — app.config.ts is seeded, never owned, so a detect-only sync must not write to it. Any later provider change ships as a migration. Default false.
